# Deborah Helps Her People (Judges 4:4)

## Emotional Focus
A wise woman helping her family and people.

## Key KJV
“And Deborah, a prophetess… judged Israel at that time.” (Judges 4:4)

## Gentle Retelling
Deborah sat under a palm tree helping her people with wise words. She loved her family and her nation and pointed them to God.

## Coloring Prompt
Deborah sitting peacefully under a palm tree speaking kindly to people.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God can use moms and grandmas to help their families.”
